title: Maximum-Feasible Automation and Non-Bypass Hardening

findings.issue: F0-INDEPENDENT-AUDIT prerequisite not changed from G1:Accepted to G2:Accepted
findings.evidence: F0-AUDIT prerequisite still requires G1:Accepted; G1 is Failed and permanently cannot reach Accepted state; validation will always block F0-AUDIT even if G2 is accepted
findings.mechanical_proof: SATISFIES["Accepted"] = {"Accepted"}; G1.execution_state = "Failed"; "Failed" not in set; blocker message confirmed by validation
findings.impact: Downstream F0-AUDIT, S02/S03/S18/S20, F1 remain permanently blocked; core G2 objective not achieved
findings.hostile_test: Calling validateControlState with requestedTask='F0-INDEPENDENT-AUDIT' returns BLOCKED error; attempting to run F0-AUDIT fails; replacing G2 prerequisite would fix issue

findings.issue: G2-G02 (correction/dependency/contamination/recovery) claims Self-check passed but dependency correction was not implemented
findings.evidence: G2 gap audit section titled 'Work after upstream failure' states 'Only explicit authorized correction transition' but prerequisite change required by that gate was not made
findings.impact: G2-G02 gate is overstated; the required dependency correction is incomplete

gates_assessment.G2-G04: Open — no change to this gate

remediation: G2 must be corrected to change F0-AUDIT prerequisite from G1:Accepted to G2:Accepted so that accepting G2 will unlock F0-AUDIT as intended
audit_notes: All other G2 mechanical safeguards (ownership lock, contamination detection, protected path declaration, residual risk disclosure) are sound. However, the primary deliverable (making G2 the replacement prerequisite for F0-AUDIT) was not implemented, making G2 unable to fulfill its purpose.
